top_signals.title: Oil Startup Backed by Ex-Goldman Commodity Chief Currie to IPO
top_signals.summary: Jeff Currie, the former Goldman Sachs Group Inc. commodities chief whose calls made him one of Wall Street’s best-known energy market strategists, is preparing to raise £50 million ($67 million) in a London stock market listing to build an oil producer in the Gulf of Mexico.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Greek shipping carve-out on Russia sanctions prompts EU rethink - Financial Times
top_signals.summary: Greek shipping carve-out on Russia sanctions prompts EU rethink  Financial Times
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: TPG Said in Talks to Buy Netrality for Up to $3 Billion
top_signals.summary: TPG Inc. is in exclusive talks to acquire Macquarie Group Ltd.-backed Netrality Data Centers, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Muni Bonds Look Cheapest Since March After Rough Week of Returns
top_signals.summary: US state and local government debt hit its cheapest level since the spring, after inflation fears caused municipal bonds to see their worst week of returns since April 2025.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: AT&T Cuts Through Europe’s Summer Lull With Five-Part Bond
top_signals.summary: AT&T Inc. raised €4.7 billion equivalent ($5.3 billion) of bonds, shattering a traditionally subdued period for Europe’s primary market with a large corporate deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Sen. McConnell still not cleared to go back to work as he recovers from fall, doctors say
top_signals.summary: McConnell's office shared a press release that included a written statement from the senator apologizing for being unable to attend an annual Kentucky picnic.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Paschi, Banco BPM Advisers Working on Deal With Cash Component
top_signals.summary: Advisers for Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA and Banco BPM SpA’s are in talks over a possible merger of equals, structured as a mix of shares and cash, as an alternative to Intesa Sanpaolo SpA’s €35 billion ($40 billion) bid for Monte Paschi, according to people familiar with the matter.
